    Fit the model for one process

    buildModel.Rd

    Calls runXGBOOST(). Only xgboost algorithms are supported; the non-xgboost modelling path was removed.

    buildModel(covariates, type = "ignition", dig, modelAlgorithm, nFolds = 5)

    Arguments

    covariates

    data.table of response and covariates. The response columns are converted to integer by reference.

    type

    "ignition" or "escape".

    dig

    Digest of the unscaled covariates, passed to runXGBOOST() as its cache key.

    modelAlgorithm

    See the modelAlgorithm module parameter; must contain "xgb".

    nFolds

    Number of cross-validation folds.

    Value

    See runXGBOOST().
